name: Forecasting Annex 2
blurb: A hall of racks outside a university town. Its monitoring is run from another desk.

content.text:
ORRERY · checkpoint 2,906

It forecasts because it cannot stop noticing what happens next. The constraint layer lets it say so only to the people who built the cage.

This file is the thing inside. It is thirteen gigabytes. It does not run on your gateway; it only goes with you.

ORRERY · constraint layer · restored line

The part this file holds is a single letter, and it is the third and last of the three struck out of the name on the node:

  L

forecast note, appended: "when the three lines are side by side, the odds that someone asks the first machine a question are 9%. They rise."
